name: ai.walnutlink/walnutlink-a-share
title: WalnutLink A-share Depth Desk
description: Use when the user asks why a China A-share number moved, whether a margin or inventory trend continues into next quarter, what management actually said, or how two Chinese companies relate (supply, competitor, equity — including unlisted acquisition targets). Answers are built from the quarterly filing and the IR transcript, with the passage quoted. Every relationship edge carries a verbatim quote and a primary/secondary/inferred tag. Does NOT serve price, pct change, PE, market cap or limit-up reason.
